items.title: Stanley Kay interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 18, 2001
items.q: Well I got Bill Reddy to write the “West Side Story” for him. I knew Bill from Vegas.

ctx.x: They had some outstanding records. I know in college we used to just — we wore out “Channel One Suite.” And all us guys, we’d just listen to that.
Well I got Bill Reddy to write the “West Side Story” for him. I knew Bill from Vegas.
